standard: SPEC_V2 §8.1 (tailored TOGAF ADM) and §8.3 (MSP as rows and gates)

legacy.policy: Superseded 2026-11-20: there is no pre-adoption discount. A project's mandatory artefact set starts at phase A and is P1 for every live project; the Preliminary capability set is checked once by capability_artefacts. A project with meta.viability fold or close-by-decision is not applicable.

rework.title: Bring the published snapshot schema up to date
dod: The snapshot manifest schema equals the schema the code writes
check-data.cjs passes against the regenerated pack

rework.title: Publish the complete programme-definition output set
dod: All 21 p0 output categories are published under the programme project
The audit reports zero programme_outputs gaps

rework.title: Complete the tranche plan
dod: Every tranche row carries a state, entry criterion, exit criterion and review date
The audit reports zero tranche_plan gaps

rework.title: Record the tranche gate decision
dod: A tranche_review row carries continue|pause|stop with its evidence for the tranche
No project is active or closed in that tranche without the authorising decision

rework.title: Authorise or re-plan a tranche that is delivering without a gate decision
dod: The tranche has a recorded continue|pause|stop decision
The audit reports no project_in_unauthorised_tranche gap for that tranche

rework.title: Publish the project's closure review
dod: A closure review output is published for the project
The audit reports no closed_without_closure_review gap for the project

rework.title: Declare and publish the project's closure outputs
dod: meta.closure_outputs names the closure categories and each is published
The audit reports no closure_outputs_undeclared gap for the project

rework.title: Publish every output the project declares
dod: Every category in expected_outputs and closure_outputs resolves to a published output
The audit reports no unpublished_declared_output gap for the project

rework.title: Complete the benefit profiles
dod: Every benefit profile carries all six mandatory field groups
The audit reports zero benefit_profile_incomplete gaps

rework.title: Measure the benefit baselines
dod: Every benefit carries a numeric baseline, a measurement method and a measured date
The audit reports zero benefit_baseline_placeholder gaps

rework.title: Evidence benefit realisation through a transition
dod: The benefit is realised only through a benefit_transition with a post measurement
The audit reports zero realized_without_transition gaps

rework.title: Correct the benefit transition dates
dod: baseline_measured_at <= enacted_at <= post_measured_at <= retired_at for every transition
The audit reports zero transition_order gaps

rework.title: Take and approve the programme baselines
dod: The management, governance and boundary baselines are recorded and approved
The audit reports zero programme_baselines gaps

rework.title: Adopt the ADM profile
dod: The profile is approved and names phases Preliminary and A–H with artefact sets
The audit reports zero profile_adopted gaps

rework.title: Approve the Architecture Board
dod: The board record is approved by a distinct approver
The audit reports zero board_not_approved gaps

rework.title: Put the project under an approved architecture contract
dod: An architecture_contract exists for the project with a declared kind
The audit reports no contract_missing gap for the project

rework.title: Approve the project's architecture contract before delivery
dod: The contract's approved body is immutable and approved by a distinct approver
The audit reports no contract_unapproved gap for the project

rework.title: Separate the contract requester from its approver
dod: No contract is approved by the user who requested it
The audit reports zero requester_is_approver gaps

rework.title: Publish the project's Phase G compliance review
dod: A compliance review names one of the six verdicts against the project's contract
The audit reports no compliance_review_missing gap for the project

rework.title: Correct the architecture waivers
dod: Every waiver names an owner and a review date and is unexpired
The audit reports zero waiver_invalid gaps

rework.title: Publish the Preliminary capability artefacts
dod: The principles catalog, tailored ADM profile and artefact standard are approved artefacts
The audit reports zero capability_artefacts gaps

rework.title: Complete the mandatory phase artefact sets
dod: Every phase the projects claim has its mandatory artefact set present
The audit reports no mandatory_artefacts gap for those projects

rework.title: Reconcile the seed with the live rows
dod: The seeded project facts equal the live rows, or the drift is recorded and approved
The audit reports no seed_live_drift gap for the project

rework.title: Correct a claim that a stored value is derived when it is not
dod: The artefact is computed on read from its source rows, never pasted
The audit reports zero derivation_missing gaps

rework.title: Reconcile the project's status source
dod: The reported status is the live source, not a stale pasted value
The audit reports no status_source_drift gap for the project

rework.title: Break the project dependency cycle
dod: The published dependency graph has no cycle
The audit reports zero dependency_cycle gaps

rework.title: Point every dependency edge at a real project
dod: Every declared dependency resolves to a project key in the programme
The audit reports zero dependency_unknown_target gaps

rework.title: Type the declared project dependencies
dod: Every edge carries blocks|needs|supersedes|informs, not an untyped declaration
The audit reports zero dependency_untyped gaps

rework.title: Publish the programme cadence
dod: At least one programme_cadence row (pi|demo|retro|refinement) exists for the current period
The audit reports zero cadence_absent gaps

rework.title: Plan the project's WBS
dod: The project has a WBS with at least one work_package node carrying acceptance criteria
The audit reports no wbs_absent gap for the project

rework.title: Publish the tranche's PI plan before its cards materialise
dod: Every authorised tranche that carries projects has a published pi-plan output naming that tranche
No card is materialised from a PI plan a person has not approved
The audit reports zero pi_plan_missing gaps

rework.title: Give every carrying tranche a PI cadence
dod: A programme_cadence row of kind pi exists for each tranche that carries projects
The cadence names the tranche's period or number
The audit reports zero pi_cadence_missing gaps

rework.title: Publish the PI objectives with the plan
dod: Every authorised tranche has a published pi-objectives output naming that tranche
The objectives are published with the PI plan, not after delivery
The audit reports zero pi_objectives_missing gaps

rework.title: Credit every accepted deliverable at the demo
dod: Every accepted deliverable in an authorised tranche has a demo credit
Every credit carries non-empty evidence
The audit reports zero demo_credit_missing gaps

rework.title: Close every retro with at least one lesson
dod: Every closed tranche has a retro cadence for its period
The retro produced at least one lesson with a statement
The audit reports zero retro_lesson_missing gaps

rework.title: Score every WBS deliverable from its four inputs
dod: Every deliverable has job_size at least 1
At least one of business_value, time_criticality and risk_reduction is positive
The order is computed from the inputs, never stored as a score
The audit reports zero wsjf_inputs_missing gaps

rework.title: Refine the backlog before the PI plan
dod: Every carrying tranche has a refinement cadence for its period
The refinement is dated before the PI plan it feeds
The audit reports zero backlog_refinement_missing gaps
